simple.meaning: שְׁלַם (shᵉlam) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to complete , to restore.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 5:16. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁלַם (H8000) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁלַם (shᵉlam) / H8000 is traced through Ezra 5:16, Ezra 7:19, Daniel 5:26 with source-language evidence and verse context.
